data.title: ST: KuCoin Will Delist Multiple Tokens on 2026-09-07
data.content:
In accordance with the Special Treatment Rules of KuCoin, the following projects will be delisted, and its associated token will be removed from the platform at 8:00 on September 7, 2026 (UTC). 

 

Project and Token to Be Delisted

  1. Across Protocol (ACX)
  2. Hydra (HYDRA)
  3. Karrat (KARRAT)
  4. Portals (PORTALS)
  5. GameFi.org (GAFI)
  6. Scor (SCOR)
  7. Audius (AUDIO)
  8. Blum (BLUM)
  9. Honey (HONEY)
  10. Nebula3 GameFi (SN3)
  11. Nobody Sausage (NOBODY)
  12. Test (TSTBSC)
  13. HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu (HPOS10I)
  14. Levva Protocol (LVVA)
  15. Meter Governance (MTRG)
  16. E Money (EMYC)
  17. DuckChain (DUCK)
  18. Jambo (J)
  19. MOVA (MOVA)
  20. Bifrost (BFC)
  21. Wen (WEN)
  22. Fwog (FWOG)
  23. GriffinAI (GAIN)
  24. WAX (WAXP)
  25. Reef (REEF)

 

The delisting process is as follows:

  1. The deposit service for the above-mentioned project(s) will be disabled at 8:00 on September 4, 2026 (UTC) and will not be resumed.

  2. KuCoin Trading Bot will delist the following tokens at 6:00 on September 7, 2026 (UTC), including Spot Grid, AI Spot Trend, Spot Martingale, Infinity Grid, DCA, Spot Grid AI Plus and Smart Rebalance. Users are advised to shut down the running Trading Bots before the time above. If the user fails to close the bot before the time above, the system will automatically shut down the relevant trading bot for the user.

  3. The projects will be delisted at 8:00 on September 7, 2026 (UTC). Users are strongly advised to update or cancel their Spot Trading orders prior to the delisting time to avoid potential losses. All trade orders will be automatically removed after trading ceases in each respective trading pair.

  4. The withdrawal service for the above-mentioned project(s) will be closed at 8:00 on October 7, 2026 (UTC). If you are currently holding any above-mentioned token(s), please withdraw them on or before the closing date.

 

Notes

  1. Please also note that during this period, if withdrawal fails due to project-related issues (including but not limited to the cessation of on-chain activities like block generation and fund transfers), KuCoin will close the withdrawal service accordingly, and will NOT be able to cover users’ losses. Thus, we strongly advise making withdrawals at your earliest convenience;

  2. To avoid potential losses, we highly recommend monitoring updates on KuCoin Delistings. You may also find the planned closing times for trading, deposits, and withdrawals of all delisted tokens, in addition to the announcements;

  3. If you have any questions, please reach out to our 24/7 customer support via Online Chat or Ticket Submission.

  4. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.

Thank you for your support!
